title: Drive the Robot!
lead: Build a program from arrows, press “Run” and help the robot collect all the crystals. “Repeat” blocks show up from level 6.
repeatHintOpen: ↑ press the arrows — they will go in here
programEmpty: Your program goes here. Press the arrows!
stopped: Stopped. You can change your program.
needArrow: Add at least one arrow to your program.
emptyRepeat: The “Repeat” block is still empty. Put some arrows inside it.

tooMany.one: Too many blocks! The limit is {count} block. Remove some or use “Repeat”.
tooMany.other: Too many blocks! The limit is {count} blocks. Remove some or use “Repeat”.

ended.one: Out of commands. Collected {got} of {count} crystal. Add more commands or try a different way.
ended.other: Out of commands. Collected {got} of {count} crystals. Add more commands or try a different way.

crashEdge: Oops! That’s the edge of the board at step {step}. The robot can’t go off the board.
tryAgainMsg: Try again: change your program and press “Run”.
notPerfect: Blocks: {blocks}. For three stars, use {par} or fewer.
tryShorter: Try to build a shorter program!
